flags.item: 44 of 188 rows cite a competition/rankings page, not a fixture-specific page
flags.detail: These rows keep their competition-level official URL; fixture detail on those rows is unverified at fixture level and is left as published with this flag (see also upstream VF-11).

flags.item: 55 rows have blank venue; 34 rows have blank team summaries; 34 rows unlined
flags.detail: Blanks are published as blank (—) per the no-inference rule; they are not errors in arithmetic but limit handicap/total origination on those rows.

flags.detail: Example nhl-2026020162: date=2026-10-22, time=2026-10-23T01:00:00Z (22 Oct evening North America). Consistent with local-date convention, but the convention is not stated on the row; flagged so readers do not read it as a wrong date.
